first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person C

entities.name: grass in front of the hedge

entities.name: gravel passage in front of the hedge
entities.identification: The light gray granular surface extending horizontally in front of the wooden pavilion and hedge and leading to the entrance.

entities.name: two light-colored benches in front of the hedge
entities.identification: The set consisting of one light-colored bench at the lower-left edge in front of the wooden pavilion and one inside the arched opening.

entities.name: dense tall branches and leaves on the image-right side of the hedge entrance
entities.identification: The area of green vegetation in the near foreground on the right side of the first frame, with a tall vertical outline and layered clusters of leaves.
